title: Stream Vortex scan as multiple RecordBatches
description: Replace the Vortex read path's scan.into_array_stream-based single-batch collection with into_record_batch_stream, and update VortexDeserializeDataTransform plus helper/read-state paths to process multiple RecordBatches/DataBlocks per Vortex file instead of forcing a single RecordBatch.
notes: Removed forced SplitBy::RowCount(8192) from Vortex scan_opened_vortex_file_to_record_batches and updated the unit test to assert default split behavior.
close_reason: Removed forced Vortex SplitBy::RowCount(8192) splitting and revalidated focused Vortex regressions.
